Bytes reflect Ghidra's initialized memory, including loader fixups. Reads stop at an unmapped or uninitialized byte and report completeness explicitly.

Initial save ordering differs; this candidate is not an exact-byte selection.
Read/write transport boundaries modeled. Byte-write wrapper validated only through decoder context.
Private nested return-address words excluded; root provider-visible saved frame and live R4-R11 compared.
